steps.label: Docker Engine
steps.sub: the daemon that builds images and runs containers, plus the docker CLI

steps.label: Docker Desktop
steps.sub: Windows/Mac app bundling Engine, a GUI, Compose, and Kubernetes

code:
# Windows (winget) -- uses the WSL 2 backend by default
winget install -e --id Docker.DockerDesktop

# macOS (Homebrew)
brew install --cask docker-desktop
# Then launch Docker.app once from Applications
# to finish setup and add `docker` to your PATH.
caption: Either way, Docker Desktop finishes its own setup after install.

code:
# Ubuntu: add Docker's official apt repository, then:
sudo apt update
sudo apt install docker-ce docker-ce-cli \
  containerd.io docker-buildx-plugin \
  docker-compose-plugin
caption: Linux runs containers natively -- Docker Engine alone is all you need.

eyebrow: Verify it worked, on any platform
code:
$ docker --version
Docker version 27.3.1, build ce12230

$ docker run hello-world
